name: db_scripts
description: Collect the database scripts of several release packages into one ordered execution plan for sqlplus.generic. Every script runs; none is merged or edited.
author: Aravinthan Selvaraj

arguments.name: release_directory
arguments.description: Folder of release packages (ZIPs or extracted folders), run in natural name order (H9 before H10). Give this or 'releases'.

arguments.name: releases
arguments.description: Release packages (ZIPs or extracted folders), run in exactly this order. Give this or 'release_directory'.

arguments.name: output_directory
arguments.description: Where DBScripts and consolidation-report.json are written; defaults to <workspace>/consolidated/db_scripts.

arguments.name: overwrite
arguments.description: Empty a non-empty output_directory first (otherwise such a folder is refused, so stale scripts are never run).

outputs.name: output_directory
outputs.description: Folder holding DBScripts (the execution plan and one folder per execution) and the report.

outputs.name: report
outputs.description: Path of consolidation-report.json: releases, the executions in order, and warnings.

outputs.name: releases
outputs.description: Release names in the order they run.

outputs.name: steps
outputs.description: The executions in order: application, release, source_application, schema and calling_script.

outputs.name: database
outputs.description: Database context with dir, scripts and execution_plan; give it to sqlplus.generic as 'execution' (plan mode).

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: True when at least one release has database scripts to run.
